title: Clear an old stopped run from Needs you
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: a stopped run stays in Needs you until a newer engine run exists for the slice (#92). The S21 run stopped 9h ago stays with no way to dismiss it. Open owner question before building: dismiss command or key, whether it is recorded, and whether it deletes the run record (retention keeps 100 finished runs, state.runs-retention).
